image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle view of a bakery display case filled with an assortment of colorful pastries and breads. The foreground features golden-brown buns and rolls on a metal tray. Behind them are various decorated cakes and pastries with pink, yellow, and white frosting, some topped with fruit or chocolate shavings. A glass partition separates the viewer from the goods, causing significant reflections and glare. In the background, blurred shapes suggest more shelves and possibly a person or mannequin, but details are obscured by the glass and depth of field.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The frosting textures appear slightly smudged and lack the crisp micro-details of real icing. Edges between different colored frostings bleed into each other unnaturally.
The buns have an overly smooth, plastic-like sheen. The 'tears' or openings in the buns look soft and ill-defined rather than having the rough texture of baked dough.
Reflections on the glass do not perfectly align with the geometry of the room or the camera angle, appearing as vague, ghostly shapes that don't correspond to clear objects.
Some pastries seem to merge slightly with the metal tray or paper liners, lacking a distinct shadow or separation line at the contact point.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'plasticity' of the food items. AI often struggles with the porous texture of bread and the viscous nature of frosting. Check if the reflections on the glass are coherent with a single light source or if they appear as random noise patterns. Verify if the 'buns' in the foreground have realistic crumb structure where torn.
